description: L-NAMOA\*dr-mvh finds the exact Pareto front with a *multi-valued heuristic* (MVH), which gives a set of estimate vectors per state instead of one. The MVH must be *admissible*: for every path from a state to a goal, some estimate is no worse than that path's cost in every objective; it need not be consistent. Each path uses the smallest estimate (in lexicographic order) that no solution dominates, and moves to the next estimate when a solution later dominates it. Like NAMOA\*dr, it skips the first objective in its dominance checks at a state, but it does a full check when a closed path there has a larger first cost. Use it with MVHs that are not consistent, such as the ones a backward A\*pex builds.

papers.authors: Maya Wolff, Ariel Felner, Oren Salzman
papers.title: Bridging Multi-Valued Heuristics and Dimensionality Reduction in Multi-Objective Search
